en: Black‑and‑white view over a cobbled main street in a European town, likely early 20th century. People walk along the street and a horse‑drawn carriage stands in the foreground. Dense rows of two‑ and three‑story houses with steep slate roofs line the street. In the background rises a large church with a tall tower and spire, and a patterned roof on the nave. On the left facade of a building there is German text advertising a business.
